title: Criciúma vs Cuiabá: Eduardo Barros's 100th game and the fight for the lead
seoTitle: Criciúma vs Cuiabá: Eduardo Barros's 100th Game
subtitle: Coach reaches 100 matches as the team looks to climb the table
excerpt: Eduardo Barros reaches the milestone of 100 games as coach facing Criciúma, as the duel decides both teams' positions in the Série B title race.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Friday, the clash between Criciúma and Cuiabá stands out as coach Eduardo Barros will complete 100 games at the helm. The milestone takes place in a decisive Série B match that could change both teams' positions in the race for the lead.

Eduardo Barros reaches the mark of 100 games

The coach completes his one-hundredth match as head coach precisely in this duel, which will be played at the Heriberto Hülse Stadium in Santa Catarina. Out of the 100 games, 51 were with Cuiabá, making him the fourth manager who has led the club the most in history, behind Itamar Schülle, Ary Marques, and António Oliveira. Barros highlighted his happiness with the achievement and hopes the milestone is just the beginning of a long journey.

Cuiabá in good form in Série B

Dourado heads into the match unbeaten in six games, totaling 36 points after 25 rounds – eight wins, 12 draws, and five losses. The defense is their strong suit, with 19 goals conceded, the second best in the competition, tied with Criciúma. On the attack, the team has scored 23 goals, one of the worst offensive rates in the competition, and leads the draw ranking, with 12 matches ending level.

Criciúma seeks to reclaim the lead

After losing the top of the table to Juventude, Criciúma needs to beat Cuiabá to return to the top. The club is in third place, with 44 points, following a three-game winless streak and two recent defeats against CRB and Fortaleza. The Santa Catarina team has the same number of points as Vila Nova, but trails on the win criteria.

Direct impact on the G-2 battle

The duel represents more than a personal milestone; it can bring Cuiabá closer to the 45 points that usually guarantee direct promotion. Meanwhile, Criciúma tries to close the gap on leader Juventude, who plays on Saturday against Atlético-GO. The match result, therefore, has the potential to influence both clubs' positions in the upcoming rounds.

Match details

The game is scheduled for 6:30 PM (Mato Grosso time) at the Heriberto Hülse Stadium. The match will be followed by fans tracking the fierce Série B race, where every point weighs heavily in the run for promotion and avoiding the relegation zone.

With information from ge, UOL.
